name: Jolt AI
title: usejolt.ai
shortDescription: Jolt AI is designed to manage and understand large codebases ranging from 100K to multi-million lines of code efficiently. It automates the process of selecting relevant files and folders, integrating multiple repositories, and adhering to coding patterns and conventions. Jolt is ideal for developers working on enterprise software across various industries such as fintech and health. An example use case is a developer using Jolt to streamline code migration and documentation creation.
cons: Limited to certain IDEs and platforms
May not support all programming languages
